## How Instant Launches work

All liquidity locked forever. Fees auto-compound.

Priced on a bonding curve

The earlier you buy, the more POOLS you get. Every purchase pushes token price higher.

Instantly tradable

Tokens can be bought and sold onchain immediately. No graduation threshold or added fees.
